args.complete_required_delivery_text:
Balance and shooting-hand roles

The UGA chapter presents balance as a foundation for shooting, particularly for beginners, and describes an approximately shoulder-width base. It assigns different roles to the hands: the dominant hand propels the ball while the other hand supports and guides it. The chapter connects aiming the shooting elbow toward the target with coordinated knee movement and bringing the ball into shooting position. Its follow-through explanation describes the ball leaving the fingertips and developing backspin.

General introductory basketball reference, selected and paraphrased from the cited chapter. No youth-specific suitability, training dose, medical clearance or planner approval is established.

Source: 4. Fundamentals – Shooting, Ch.1 - Basketball, UGA PEDB Program. https://open.online.uga.edu/basketball/chapter/fundamentals-shooting/
